model.name: merge.saveButtonState
model.description: After a SUCCESSFUL save the Save button turns GREEN (saved indicator). On ANY subsequent change (add/remove side, edit) the Save button returns to DEFAULT (unsaved indicator). Reflects the R30.35 change model (any addSide/removeLine = a change) + the R30.38 save success. v0.7.76 RECONCILE: '• modified' text dropped from de-status — the Save button ('✓ Saved' / '💾 Save') is now the SOLE saved-signal (removes the double-signal the architect flagged). Behavior (GREEN-on-save / DEFAULT-on-change) unchanged; the redundant status text is gone.
